translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked Da Hong'a for having retreated first, stripped him of office, and ordered him to remain with the army to redeem himself through service.

sentences.zh: 四年，敗賊獻縣，復原官。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he defeated rebels at Xian County and was restored to his original office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1854 he defeated rebels at Xian County and was restored to his former rank.

sentences.zh: 尋追賊阜城，受傷，卒於軍。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he pursued rebels to Fucheng, was wounded, and died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He soon pursued the rebels to Fucheng, was wounded, and died in camp.

sentences.zh: 贈都統銜，予騎都尉兼一云騎尉世職，諡壯武。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted the rank of Commander-in-Chief, given the hereditary ranks of Cavalry Commandant and one Cloud Cavalry Commandant, and given the posthumous name Zhuangwu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted commander-in-chief rank, awarded the hereditary ranks of Cavalry Commandant and Cloud Cavalry Commandant, and given the posthumous name Zhuangwu.

sentences.zh: 姚瑩自有傳。

translations.literal: Yao Ying has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Ying has a biography of his own.

sentences.zh: 論曰：林則徐才略冠時，禁煙一役，承宣宗嚴切之旨，操之過急；

translations.literal: The commentary says: Lin Zexu's talent and strategy surpassed his age; in the opium prohibition campaign he carried out Emperor Xuanzong's stern and urgent orders, but handled matters too hastily;
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: Lin Zexu's talent and strategic vision were unmatched in his day. In the opium suppression campaign he carried out Emperor Xuanzong's stern orders, but pressed the policy too hard;

sentences.zh: 及敵氛蹈瑕他犯，遂遭讒屏斥。

translations.literal: when the enemy seized on a flaw and invaded elsewhere, he then suffered slander and was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: when the enemy exploited the opening and struck elsewhere, he fell victim to slander and was driven from office.

sentences.zh: 論者謂粵事始終倚之，加之操縱，潰裂當不致此。

translations.literal: Commentators say that if the Guangdong affair had relied on him throughout and given him control, the collapse would not have reached this point.
translations.idiomatic: Some argue that if Guangdong affairs had been entrusted to him throughout and he had been given full control, the collapse would never have gone so far.

sentences.zh: 則徐瀕謫，疏陳：「自道光元年以來，粵關徵銀三千餘萬兩，收其利必防其害。

translations.literal: As Lin faced dismissal, he submitted a memorial stating: 'Since the first year of Daoguang, the Guangdong customs have collected more than thirty million taels of silver; in reaping its benefits one must guard against its harm.
translations.idiomatic: On the verge of dismissal, Lin memorialized: 'Since 1821 the Guangdong customs have collected more than thirty million taels of silver. Whoever reaps such profit must also guard against its harm.

sentences.zh: 使以關稅十分之一制砲造船，制夷已可裕如。

translations.literal: If one-tenth of the customs revenue were used to cast cannon and build ships, controlling the barbarians would already be ample.'
translations.idiomatic: If even one-tenth of customs revenue were devoted to casting cannon and building ships, we would already have ample means to check the foreigners.'

sentences.zh: 」誠為讜論。

translations.literal: ' This was truly sound counsel.
translations.idiomatic: That was sound counsel indeed.

sentences.zh: 惟當時內治廢弛，外情隔膜，言和言戰，皆昧機宜，其禍豈能倖免哉？

translations.literal: Only at that time internal governance was lax, foreign conditions were poorly understood, and whether speaking of peace or war all failed to grasp the proper moment—how could such calamity have been escaped?
translations.idiomatic: Yet at the time internal governance was slack, foreign realities were poorly understood, and whether advisers spoke for peace or war none grasped the moment. How could disaster have been avoided?

sentences.zh: 鄧廷楨與則徐同心禦侮，克保岩疆。

translations.literal: Deng Tingzhen and Lin Zexu joined in heart to resist insult and were able to preserve the rocky frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Tingzhen worked in full concert with Lin to resist foreign aggression and successfully defended the coastal frontier.

sentences.zh: 若達洪阿、姚瑩卻敵台灣，固由守禦有方，亦因敵非專注，朝廷皆不得已而罪之，諸人卒皆復起，而名節播宇內、煥史冊矣。

translations.literal: As for Da Hong'a and Yao Ying repelling the enemy in Taiwan, it was indeed because their defense was well ordered, but also because the enemy was not fully focused; the court punished them all under unavoidable circumstances, yet these men all eventually rose again, and their reputations spread throughout the realm and shine upon the historical record.
translations.idiomatic: As for Da Hong'a and Yao Ying driving back the enemy in Taiwan, their success owed something to sound defense but also to the fact that the enemy was not fully committed. The court punished them under political necessity, yet all eventually rose again, and their reputations spread throughout the empire and endure brightly in the historical record.
